clue.text: Warmer, in the main

parts.note: the main is the open sea, and this Atlantic current carries warm water across it to north-west Europe

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that things are warmer, on the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'mostly', but here the main is the sea; the clue describes the ocean current that warms Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: Cryptic description: a warm Atlantic ocean current flowing through the sea, which old poetry calls the main.

clue.text: A preposition taking an adverb is still a superior preposition

indicators.note: one piece taking on another means the two are joined side by side

parts.note: up is a preposition, as in up the hill
on is an adverb, as in carry on

explanation.surface: A grammar lesson: a preposition plus an adverb still makes a preposition, only a grander one.
explanation.walkthrough: The finished word is itself a preposition, a slightly loftier form of 'on' — and literally 'up', hence superior.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal preposition meaning on top of, so it is literally a preposition of higher position.

clue.text: A learner joins class that's methodical

parts.note: a form is a school class in Britain
L is the learner plate on a British car

explanation.surface: A new student joins a school class that runs in an orderly way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done according to set rules and procedure is orderly or methodical in manner.

clue.text: Old newspaper leader?

parts.note: in ancient Rome this official was a leader who protected the plebs, and the same title names many newspapers

explanation.surface: A question about the head of a newspaper from times past.
explanation.walkthrough: It reads like an editor; in fact it is the Roman people's magistrate, a title many newspapers have borrowed.
explanation.definitionFit: A Roman magistrate elected to defend the common people, and a common masthead name for papers.

clue.text: Where needles are kept, just in case

definitions.text: Where needles are kept, just in case

parts.words: Where needles are kept, just in case
parts.note: 'just in case' sounds like 'as a precaution' but literally the needles are kept in a small case

explanation.surface: Someone stores needles somewhere as a precaution.
explanation.definitionFit: A small ornamental case for holding needles, pins and sewing items, familiar from crosswords.

clue.text: Cast meet in a theatre production

indicators.note: to cast is to throw about, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Actors in the cast gather for a stage show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' looks like the actors, but it signals the anagram of MEET IN A.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon performance of a play is one kind of theatre show.

clue.text: Hopeless couple taken in by bad design

indicators.note: one piece taken in by another sits inside it
bad suggests the letters of the word are spoilt into a new order

parts.note: a couple is a pair

explanation.surface: Two people are fooled by a poor plan and lose hope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' signals the rearrangement of the design, and 'taken in by' puts the couple inside it; 'Hopeless' is the definition, not a description of the plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without any hope is the state of utter despondency described here.

clue.text: Ominous leaking about camping equipment

indicators.note: one word placed about another surrounds it

parts.note: something porous lets liquid through, so it leaks
a tent is the basic piece of camping kit

explanation.surface: A leaking tent on a camping trip is a bad sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something that foreshadows trouble, warning of what is to come.

clue.text: Girl's love for a brave man?

parts.note: a girl's thing is her thing
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A girl's affection is reserved for a courageous man.
explanation.walkthrough: Fittingly, in Greek myth Hero was also a girl, the lover of Leander.
explanation.definitionFit: A man admired for courage is a champion or valiant figure.

clue.text: Our quintet needs arrangement for one instrument

indicators.note: the words must be arranged anew, as a piece of music is

explanation.surface: Five musicians must arrange a piece for a single instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: The musical surface misleads: the instrument is a surgical one, a band to stop bleeding.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical device tightened round a limb to stop bleeding is a medical instrument.

clue.text: Place for old writers to take a dip

definitions.text: Place for old writers to take a dip

parts.words: Place for old writers to take a dip
parts.note: writers using old dip pens dipped them into a little pot of ink

explanation.surface: A bathing spot for retired authors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writers' sounds like authors going for a swim, but they are the pens that once dipped into ink.
explanation.definitionFit: A small vessel holding ink, into which pen nibs were dipped before writing.

clue.text: Go through the cases but don't accept any

definitions.meaning: to run through a noun's grammatical cases, nominative, accusative and so on
to refuse an offer or invitation

explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, to inflect a noun through its cases; otherwise, to turn down politely.

clue.text: Refuse to give credit

parts.note: credit here is belief rather than money: to refuse it is to not believe

explanation.surface: A lender will not extend a loan.
explanation.walkthrough: The financial reading misleads; to give credit is to believe someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To refuse to accept something as true, giving it no credence.

clue.text: Does bootlegging intrigue?

parts.note: does as a verb, cons, means swindles
illegal copying of recordings is piracy

explanation.surface: A question whether smuggling liquor is fascinating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Does' is not an auxiliary verb but means swindles; 'intrigue' is a noun, a plot.
explanation.definitionFit: An intrigue is a secret plot, the same as a scheme hatched by plotters.

clue.text: Female novelist and male poet to lie awkwardly together

indicators.note: lying awkwardly means the letters sit in a clumsy new order

explanation.surface: Two writers of opposite sexes are made to lie together uncomfortably.
explanation.walkthrough: The surname belongs to both George, who wrote Middlemarch, and T S, who wrote The Waste Land.
explanation.definitionFit: Shared surname of George, a woman writing fiction, and T S, a man writing verse.

clue.text: Notices amended in part

indicators.note: letters amended are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Some public notices have been partially revised.
explanation.definitionFit: A section is one portion or division of a whole.

clue.text: The sprinter's capacity for a drug

definitions.meaning: a runner's ability to go fast

explanation.definitionFit: Quickness is what a sprinter has; also street slang for amphetamine stimulants.

clue.text: Fly to an away match

parts.note: to run off to marry is to fly to a match, a wedding, away from home

explanation.surface: A fan flies out to watch the team play away.
explanation.walkthrough: The sporting surface misleads: the match is a marriage, and fly means run away.
explanation.definitionFit: Running away secretly to get married, a match made away from the family.

clue.text: Contrarily, Ena's being reasonable

indicators.note: reading contrarily means going the opposite way, right to left

parts.note: the name Ena with its S kept

explanation.surface: Ena, against expectations, is being sensible.
explanation.definitionFit: Being of sound, rational mind is the same as being sensible and reasonable.

clue.text: Pool in which duck's after cover

indicators.note: the duck's piece comes after the cover's piece

parts.note: a lid covers a pot
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, the letter O

explanation.surface: A duck is following its cover in a pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' is the cricket term for a score of nought.
explanation.definitionFit: A public open-air swimming pool is known in Britain by this Italian-derived name.

clue.text: He wants a hand

parts.note: asking for a woman's hand means proposing marriage

explanation.surface: A man needs some help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wants a hand' sounds like needing help, but it is a hand in marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor who courts a woman seeks her hand in marriage.

clue.text: We idled around when employed

indicators.note: letters turned around are moved into a different order

explanation.surface: We lazed around while supposed to be working.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool wielded is used or put to work, so it is employed.

clue.text: Explorer with a girl he seduced

indicators.note: seduced means led astray, so the letters stray into a new order

explanation.surface: An adventurer took a girl he had seduced along with him.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Walter, the Elizabethan explorer, did secretly marry a lady-in-waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Walter, the Elizabethan adventurer, voyaged to the Americas.

clue.text: Make the most of an adventure

definitions.meaning: to use something to full advantage

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to use fully for gain; as a noun, a bold or heroic feat.

clue.text: Mother loses youth, gets some compensation

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal
someone who ages is losing their youth

explanation.surface: A mother growing old gets a payout.
explanation.walkthrough: DAM is a horse's or other animal's mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Money awarded by a court as compensation for loss or injury.

clue.text: A naval officer bearing star

parts.note: Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant
an air is a person's bearing or manner

explanation.surface: A naval officer has the bearing of a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: The brightest star in the constellation Aquila is named this.

clue.text: Real restructuring is beginning somewhere in the Middle East

indicators.note: the word is comes at the start
restructuring rebuilds the letters in a new order

explanation.surface: A genuine reorganisation is starting in a Middle Eastern region.
explanation.definitionFit: The nation on the Mediterranean's eastern shore is a Middle Eastern country.

clue.text: Goddess is after Spanish agreement being lifted

indicators.note: the word is comes after the turned piece
in a down clue, lifting a word reads it from bottom to top

parts.note: si is Spanish for yes

explanation.surface: A goddess follows when a Spanish yes is raised.
explanation.definitionFit: Egyptian deity of motherhood and magic, wife of Osiris.

clue.text: Navy gets one miserable?

explanation.definitionFit: A colour, as in navy; and in idiom, sad or down in spirits.

clue.text: Special bed you can make low

indicators.note: making something from these letters means building a new word out of them

explanation.surface: Anyone can make a special bed low down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make' suggests making a bed, but signals the rearrangement of SPECIAL BED.
explanation.definitionFit: Contemptible, mean and base behaviour is described as low.

clue.text: In place of depravity

explanation.definitionFit: A Latin preposition meaning instead of; and a word for wickedness.

clue.text: Daughter is accused, but let off

parts.note: someone accused of a crime has been charged

explanation.surface: A daughter faces charges but is released.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let off' could be the gun reading or release; both fit.
explanation.definitionFit: Released from custody or duty, or fired as a gun is.
